How to share with students:
1. Add all student URLs here in admin panel
2. Click 🔄 Re-scan to discover all task pages
3. Click ⬇ Download shareable HTML
4. Upload the downloaded file to your GitHub repo's docs/ folder as showcase.html
5. Students open muxiddin19.github.io/WebPro/showcase.html
All data is baked in — no localStorage needed.

Why other browsers show no links:
Student URLs are saved in YOUR browser's localStorage, invisible to other browsers/devices. The downloaded shareable HTML has all URLs baked in, so anyone can open it.

For shared reactions:
Create a free Firebase Realtime Database at console.firebase.google.com, set rules to public read/write, paste its URL above, then re-download the shareable HTML.
